messages.author: aa69195a52cb2718
messages.subject: rstan 2.4.0 requires R >= 3.0.2?
parts:
When I try to install the latest version of Stan, I get the following error:

ERROR: this R is version 3.0.0, package 'rstan' requires R >= 3.0.2

rstan_2.3.0.tar.gz installs without any problems, so this should probably be added to the release notes (and the quickstart guide). I get this problem on Suse Linux as well as Windows 7 (x64).

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: rstan 2.4.0 requires R >= 3.0.2?
parts: That is correct, but I don't remember why. It might have been a Mac thing only or something. The quickstart always suggests the most recently released R because we don't test older versions.
